name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI coding assistants like Claude Code remember more, follow security rules, and work faster across sessions, basically a performance and memory upgrade for an AI coding tool.
buyer: A developer frustrated their AI coding assistant forgets context between sessions and wants it to perform closer to a senior engineer's memory.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs it across every client project to cut time re-explaining context to their AI assistant each session, billing fewer hours for the same output.
A dev-tools reviewer builds an audience comparing agent-harness upgrades like this one.
It's a dev-only productivity layer; there is no clear path from here to a customer-facing product beyond consulting.

money_ideas.idea: The project already monetizes directly via its own Pro tier and GitHub App, leaving little room for a third party to build a business on top

steal_this: Honestly, there isn't much of a weekend 'steal this' here for a non-developer; it's a tool developers use on their own machines, not a product you resell.
